name: manual_3afc37
claim: PT .agent memory pipeline had unencoded open() calls scattered across graduate.py, render_lessons.py, learn.py beyond the two files fixed earlier (promote.py, auto_dream.py) - the UTF-8 codec bug on Windows cp1252 recurs at every new read site until the whole call chain is audited, not just the entry point

decisions.notes: learn.py -> graduate.py -> render_lessons.py each independently crashed on the same lessons.jsonl/LESSONS.md em-dash bytes because each had its own unencoded open(). Fixed graduate.py:57,140 and all 4 remaining calls in render_lessons.py in one pass instead of whack-a-mole. Full sweep of .agent/tools/*.py and .agent/memory/*.py still has ~15 more unencoded open() calls (recall.py, show.py, skill_loader.py, decay.py, review_state.py) not yet fixed - flagged as follow-up, not blocking.
